provenance.note: This is an unofficial community database. It is used to cross-check identities and metadata, not to derive executable behavior.

The runtime snapshot is reproduced by the Naruto Card Game Simulator data except for one recorded N-sakura damage override retained from ExBurst. Five cross-source conflicts and two ExBurst-only sample cards remain explicit in the checked-in snapshot.

limitations: Both card catalogs are unofficial community sources.
Cross-source conflicts are not silently resolved into engine behavior.
The checked-in data does not establish catalog completeness or authoritative wording.

checks: per-source payload SHA-256 and card counts
verification.reproduction: Run the opt-in live scraper to refresh the checked-in community snapshot, review every reported conflict and identity inference, then run pnpm run verify-provenance. A primary-source importer still does not exist.
